title: nan
authors: Lu J.; Shen H.; Pan L.; Zhang X.; Tian B.; Zong Q.
key_contribution: Proposes a multi-UAV relative localization (SLAM) and motion planning framework explicitly for GPS-denied environments with experimental validation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
